annotations.title: Demand and pricing check for a rental property

description: For a vacation rental or hotel owner: how busy each night will be around their property for the next weeks (concerts, festivals, carnivals, conventions, pro and college home games, public holidays and long weekends, weekends), compared with a typical night there. With their calendar's iCal export link (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Hostaway, Guesty, OwnerRez...) it marks booked and open nights; with their nightly rate it flags nights priced too low for the demand and suggests a range. Use when a host asks whether their price is too low, what's happening in town, or when to raise rates.

days.description: Nights to check (default 35; events are listed about 5 weeks ahead, holidays further).

ical.description: The listing's calendar export (iCal, .ics) link. Airbnb: Calendar > Availability > Connect calendars > Export. Vrbo: Calendar > Import/Export > Export. Read once, never stored.

location.description: Where the property is: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a town with state or country ('Destin, FL', 'Tulum'), or a Veabird beach resort name.

radiusMiles.description: How far an event still sends guests to this property (default 25; use ~10 in a big city, 40+ for a remote area).

rate.description: The property's normal nightly rate (USD or local currency).

rates.description: Current nightly rates for specific dates, e.g. ['2026-10-17=189','2026-10-18=189'].
